          Good phone , initially i was sceptical due to people mentioning poor battery life. But now after updating to latest one ui 8 it seems samsung has mostly fixed it.

          Battery life is good for me. I usually do doom scrolling instagram youtube etc , capture photos , shoot videos occassionally. It works great for me. Easily lasting 13-14 hrs a day.

          Has some really good inbuilt editing tools for image and videos. Night photography is also really good. Phone do becomes hot sometimes while fast charging , or shooting long videos. But it also has great cooling mechanism so doesn't bother much.

          Display is also really good.

          Video quality in camera needs to be improved as zooming in adds so much noise. Fingerprint sensor also works fine , but if you add screen guard . You need to register your fingerprints again. Overall good value for the money.

          Camera – 4.5/5

          The camera performs really well. It captures great photos even in low-light conditions. Video quality is also impressive and very stable. The phone supports 8K at 30 FPS, and it works smoothly without any issues.

          Battery – 3/5

          The battery could have been better. With continuous usage, the battery backup lasts around 5–6 hours, so I usually have to charge the phone twice a day.

          Performance – 3.5/5

          Performance has been good so far, and I haven’t faced any major issues with the Exynos processor. However, there is a noticeable heating problem, as the phone tends to get warm quite quickly during heavy use.

          Display – 5/5

          The display is next level. It is bright, smooth, and very enjoyable to watch content on. The biometric sensor also works accurately and quickly.

          Storage – 3/5

          The 128 GB storage feels quite limited. Recording just 20–30 videos of 1–2 minutes each in UHD 60 FPS almost filled up the storage.

          Overall:

          A very good phone with an excellent camera and display, but the battery backup and storage disappointed me a little. Go for 256 GB storage at least..
